title: Complex analytic germs at the origin
statement: For $d\in\mathbf N$, let $G_d$ be the subtype of germs at $0\in\mathbf C^d$ of complex-valued functions admitting a representative $f:\mathbf C^d\to\mathbf C$ analytic at zero, where analytic means locally represented by a convergent complex power series [lem-sfb-complex-analytic-function-operations]. Germ equivalence is equality on some neighbourhood of zero. Only local analyticity of a representative is required; no global extension property is required. In particular $d=0$ is allowed.

source.place: Frenkel, Séminaire H. Cartan 1951–52, exposé 10, §4, printed pp.6–7; https://www.numdam.org/item/SHC_1951-1952__4__A10_0.pdf. Positive polyradii, convergent scalar series and functions analytic at the origin; explicit subtype formulation for the weighted Taylor Banach model.
